name: gpu-lock
description: One CUDA job at a time, or shared up to a memory limit: locks the GPU across sessions, checks free memory first, and shows who runs and who waits.

mode.title: GPU mode
mode.description: exclusive runs one GPU job at a time. shared lets several run together while their memory stays under the limit below.

maxVramPercent.title: Shared memory limit (%)
maxVramPercent.description: In shared mode, GPU jobs together may use this share of the card's memory. The first job on an idle card only has to fit in the free memory.

waitSeconds.title: Wait for the lock (seconds)
waitSeconds.description: How long a GPU command waits for the lock before it is refused. 0 refuses at once.

minFreeMiB.title: Least free GPU memory (MiB)
minFreeMiB.description: A GPU command is refused when less than this is free. A command can set its own need with # gpu 8g.

band.title: Band above the prompt
band.description: auto shows it while the GPU is locked or a job waits; always also shows it when the GPU is free; never hides it.

extraPatterns.title: Extra GPU commands
extraPatterns.description: Regular expressions, one per line. A command that matches one counts as a GPU job.

skipPatterns.title: Commands to skip
skipPatterns.description: Regular expressions, one per line. A command that matches one never counts as a GPU job.

lockPath.title: Lock file
lockPath.description: The file every session locks. Shell scripts can use it too: flock <file> <command>.
